item.title: 【Requests】[REQ CAP] - AI Outpainting Turns Drake & Josh Into Widescreen (16:9)
item.description:
AI outpainting, particularly using models like Stable Diffusion (SDXL/Flux), is being used by creators on platforms like Reddit to transform 4:3 (square) television shows, including
Drake and Josh, into 16:9 widescreen formats. This process expands the scene by hallucinating new details on the sides of the original image, making older shows appear as if they were filmed for modern TVs.
